Screenshots and GIFs for the top-level README. chezmoi ignores this folder
(source paths starting with "." are never deployed).

The files here are placeholders. Replace each with a real capture under the SAME
name: desktop.png (16:10, the hero), lockscreen.png, menus.png, terminal.png,
theming.gif, crash-diagnose.gif. Keep each under ~3 MB.
Stills: `shot all` / `shot monitor`. GIFs: wf-recorder to MP4, then ffmpeg to GIF.
